Retrieve a Health Insurance Quote > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEInsurance.AEInsuranceResourceIdentifierType

{
  "type": "string",
  "minLength": 1,
  "maxLength": 128,
  "description": "Unique identifier for a given insurance policy. \n\nA uuid v4 is recommended for consistency but not mandatory."
}

Retrieve a Health Insurance Quote > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEInsurance.AEActiveOrHistoricCurrencyCode

{
  "type": "string",
  "pattern": "^[A-Z]{3,3}$",
  "description": "A 3 character alphabetic code allocated to a currency under an international currency identification scheme, as described in the latest edition of the international standard ISO 4217 'Codes for the representation of currencies and funds'.",
  "example": "AED"
}

Retrieve a Health Insurance Quote > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEInsurance.AEActiveOrHistoricAmount

{
  "type": "string",
  "pattern": "^\\d{1,16}\\.\\d{2}$",
  "description": "A number of monetary units specified in an active currency where the unit of currency is explicit and compliant with ISO 4217.",
  "example": "100.00"
}

Retrieve a Health Insurance Quote > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEInsurance.AEInsurancePercentageValue

{
  "type": "number",
  "format": "decimal",
  "minimum": 0,
  "maximum": 100
}

{
  "type": "number",

  "maximum": 100,
  "multipleOf": 0.1,

}
